name: Pawmot

abilities.name: Electrocreation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may take a {Lightning} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the {Lightning} Pokémon in the Active Spot.

flavor:
This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once
it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies
with lightning-fast movements.
